_comment: Absolute mean-time budgets in nanoseconds per criterion bench id (decision 0004). Set at roughly 25-30x the reference machine's means so CI runner slowness never trips them but an order-of-magnitude regression always does. Reference means (2026-07, Windows dev host): params_default 35ns, weighted_event_new 3.5ns, apply_first_event 69ns, apply_existing_state 116ns, replay_1000_events 293us, supersession_1000_events 12us, state_view 16ns, evidence_trail_100_events 334ns, codec_compress_4k_plain 11us, codec_compress_4k_dict 28us, codec_decompress_4k_plain 2.1us, codec_decompress_4k_dict 6.7us, codec_train_dictionary_200_samples 9.0ms. Exception: preprocess_page_a4 (reference mean 408ms on a 300dpi A4 synthetic page) is budgeted at the guide's hard 2s-per-page SLO, not 25-30x, because that SLO is the thing worth gating; the ~5x headroom still absorbs CI slowness while catching a real regression.
